title: Session switching with substantial workspace panels
description: Measure cold and warm historical session switching within and across workspaces with the workspace panel closed, on a substantial Files surface, and on a substantial Diff surface. Each open profile uses a distinct canonical destination so cold and warm semantics remain valid; the framework derives open-minus-closed penalties.

metrics.description: Trusted session activation to correct content, above-the-fold paint, and interactive readiness for each panel profile and cache/workspace lane.
Framework-derived Files-minus-closed and Diff-minus-closed duration and renderer-work deltas for each cache/workspace lane.
Per-switch renderer task, script, style-recalculation, and layout work, with bounded raw long-animation-frame attribution.
